segmentedPavilion.review: Not selected: the keyed endpoints are closer, but connectors detach and the canopy stretches during intermediate motion.

reviews: Promising: the cube stays more consistent and the bridge has an explicit stowed mechanism. Some support edges still shift. Review before replacing the approved reference.
Needs another pass: the arm still gains a joint and the arch is already present before the drawing action. Stronger prompting alone has not resolved those continuity errors.
The travel is clearer, but the model changes the station count compared with the reference. Check the track topology rather than accepting the styling alone.
Strongest candidate in this pass: a staged drawer reveal, with the four small builds held steady, reduces competing motion. Leg deployment and ground contact still need close review.
Single-pass GIF: incomplete upright. Segmented pilot: closer end poses, but detached connectors and stretching canopy. Both remain rejected experiments.
methodFinding: Single approved master + fixed inventory + fewer simultaneous actions improved the workshop reveal. Neither long prompts nor fixed endpoints alone reliably enforce topology in all generated intermediate frames. Do not replace approved animations with failed candidates.
